name: Shining Beacon
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, hope, mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, paladin 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Effect 30ft. aura centered on the caster
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Upon completion of this spell you are limned in a nimbus of light that shines like a torch, you gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma and are immune to fear and despair effects. Additionally you exude an aura of hope granting all allies within 30 feet a +1 morale bonus on saving throws, attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls. The bonus to saving throws is increased to +4 vs. fear and despair effects.

Any ally under the effect of a despair or fear effect that enters the aura is granted an immediate save to end the effect with the bonus provided by the aura.
